title: OPERA Maximum Vegetation Anomaly (DIST-ALERT VEG-ANOM-MAX)
description:
Researchers working with the Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA) and Observational Products for End-Users from Remote Sensing Analysis (OPERA) teams at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, Pasadena, California, produce the OPERA Land Surface Disturbance Alert (DIST-ALERT) products. Results posted here are preliminary, primarily intended to aid field response, and are provided with absolutely no warranty of any kind. Use at your own risk.
Each image is the VEG-ANOM-MAX layer, which reports the maximum vegetation anomaly observed for each pixel over the detection window, expressed as the percent of vegetation cover lost. This is a continuous magnitude, not a class layer, so it is rendered with a continuous colormap ramp and a rescale rather than a discrete colormap.
Pixel values are the maximum vegetation anomaly over the detection window, in percent of vegetation cover lost (0-100). 255 is the product's no-data flag and is declared `nodata` so it cannot clamp to the top of the rescale; 0 means no anomaly was observed and is kept as real data rather than masked.
